import math
import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    a, b, n = map(int, input_data)
    g = math.gcd(a, b)
    a //= g
    b //= g
    best_num = 1000000000
    best_den = 1
    if b <= n:
        print(f"{a}/{b}")
        return
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        candidate = (a * i) // b
        if best_den * abs(a * i - candidate * b) < i * abs(a * best_den - best_num * b):
            best_num = candidate
            best_den = i
        candidate += 1
        if best_den * abs(a * i - candidate * b) < i * abs(a * best_den - best_num * b):
            best_num = candidate
            best_den = i
    print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
